CREATE TRIGGER jairoads_dd_auditlog_reject_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON jairoads_next.audit_logs FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION jairoads_next.jairoads_dd_auditlog_deny_mutation()

audit_function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION jairoads_next.jairoads_dd_auditlog_deny_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'JaiROADS Data Dictionary AuditLog is append-only: % is forbidden', TG_OP
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    RETURN NULL;
END;
$function$
